title: Toward bootstrapping tensor-network contractions
summary: Accurate contraction of tensor networks beyond one dimension is essential in various fields including quantum many-body physics. Existing approaches typically rely on approximate contraction schemes and do not provide certified error bars. We introduce a numerical bootstrap framework which casts the problem of tensor-network contractions into a convex optimization problem, thereby yielding certified lower and upper bounds on expectation values of physical observables.
